notes.title: Full Release 1.0.80
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
-  Significant AI Performance improvement in large scale scenarios (Luke) - when AI has a lot of units performance could dramatically slow down. This has been significantly reduced (on order of 7 times faster).  Please watch for strange behavior around AI Bolstered attacks in particular shooting (this is where the performance gain was made, the AI was expensively building at too many possible plans to implement as opposed to figuring out optimal targeting quickly and just working on a plan for that).
- Max 150 saves message now warns must turn off Steam cloud while delete (Luke) - or will get readded by cloud ;-)

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
- Crash: ‘SufficientOrdersNChkResult' object has no attribute 'get_action_state'’ (Henk, Luke)

- Misreporting Orders insufficient for costs of a plan when weren’t (Luke) -a confusing popup right said a plan could not be afforded by AI but reported in a way that looked like could be afforded! In short confusing .
- Flags - c08: Several minor bugs in text courtesy of Kiks.
- San Frattello - c09: Grammatical error. Death to the grammar errors!

notes.title: Rollback to patch 1.0.19!

Today's bug-fix patch 1.0.20 unfortunately introduced a new bug in the target and shoot code, preventing players from actually shooting at the enemy. Since being able to actually fire a weapon at the enemy is pretty important to wining the game... ;-) we have rolled the Steam build back to 1.0.19.

We will address the issue with 1.0.20 tomorrow and a proper bug-fix patch out then.

notes.title: Update notes for patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
This is a "quick patch" as we are noticing some players are experiencing game crashes when their Firewall blocks access to manage the game logs and saved games. We write and manipulate logs to help with debugging, plus saved games require manipulating files on the player's hard drive. 

This patch eliminates SOME file manipulation to reduce the firewall impact. 

If players are still seeing crashes when trying to save the game (which happens automatically between each turn), please see the FAQ on the BoC Steam Community Discussion page for how to check and allow Firewall access and prevent this.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/887490/discussions/0/600775246650303986/

notes.title: Burden of Command - Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Save the Date: April 8th, 2025[/b][/h3]
We’re thrilled to announce that Burden of Command will officially launch on April 8th! It’s been a long journey, but the finish line is finally in sight—and we can’t wait for you to experience the full campaign.

[h3][b]New Trailer Out Now[/b][/h3]
To mark the occasion, we’ve just released a brand new trailer, now live on both Steam and YouTube. It’s a fresh look at the leadership challenges, tactical decisions, and emotional moments that define Burden of Command. Make sure to check it out and let us know what you think!

[previewyoutube=k3fdOFUFKVQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]A Heartfelt Thank You[/b][/h3]
We wouldn’t be here without you—our community of players, history buffs, wargamers, and storytellers. Your support, feedback, and belief in this unique project have carried us through development. We hope we’ve made a game worthy of your trust, and we can’t wait to hand you the Burden of Command this April.

See you on the battlefield,
The Burden of Command Team

notes.title: Update on our progress
notes.notes:
[h2]Since you've been asking where things stand we thought it was a good time for a quick update. We don't have a release date yet, but we are making great progress and have tested most of our planned scenarios.

In the scenarios we've tested so far, the Cottonbalers' opponents were on the defensive; we did those first because the AI was easier to write. We're working on the offensive AI now, and when it's ready (soon!) we will have seven remaining scenarios to test.

Then all those scenarios will be integrated into a true narrative campaign, and we'll need to add and playtest the RPG mechanics. And of course there will be fine tuning, balance, and polish.

It's all starting to come together, so remember to check back all the time because we have regular updates here on Steam, and on our [url=https://twitter.com/BurdenOfCommand]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6D1rHMFvqsVM1ICFVQFXOA]Youtube[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/burdenofcommand]Facebook[/url] pages.[/h2]

notes.title: Double Update Friday!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Again!

That's right, today we offer you [b][u]t[/u][u]wo updates in one[/u][/b]!

You may have seen Burden of Command's development roadmap in the discussions area. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/cbaa598143a1dddda16a10ec9c5e4720729473e1.jpg[/img]

The subjects of today's updates are the first two items on the roadmap.

[b][u]Update #1: Basic Tactical Features[/u][/b]

As a Commanding Officer, you will face many tactical dilemmas. The battlefield is a chaotic and deadly place. 

What is that ahead? It's...It's...TANKS!!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/29812dcbeccdcad24fa00ab49b3302d3f35efe72.png[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H1Hc9N635hM]Watch this video[/url] to see an example of the tough battlefield choices you'll have to make.


[b][u]Update #2: Narrative[/u][/b]

Not all decisions happen on the battlefield...

You happen upon a local. He claims to have useful information. He says he wants to help. Can you trust him?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/6ab2dc90aed4164c098e28a00a11630e9ea23c2b.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w76RbicNN9o]Watch this video[/url] for a taste of the narrative choices you will face.

You are in Command, Captain. You have your mission. Your men's lives are in your hands. What will you do?

I hope you liked these sneak peeks.

As always, we would greatly appreciate adding Burden of Command to your wishlist and [url=http://eepurl.com/cLtwsj]joining our newsletter[/url] to get even more news and updates.

We'll be back tomorrow with even more news!

Rob
[/h1]
